full_judgment: 30. Exhibit-1 is Cadastral Survey Record of Right containing CS Plot No. 254 (in full) measuring an area of .61 acres, Exhibit-2 is Gazate Notification dated 25-11-1965 and Gazette Notification was published in exercise of power conferred by sub-section (b) of section 93A of Town Improvement Act XIII of 1953 (Act of 1953). In schedule noted in Gazette Notification CS plot No. 254 (in full) are being more or less 14.2118 acres along with other plots had been listed. Exhibit-3 is Standard Lease Agreement dated 6-4-1981 for residential property between Dhaka Improvement Trust on the one part who is called the Lessor and Manager Bangladesh Bank, Dhaka referred to as Lessee or the other part. In schedule of Lease Agreement, area of property leased out is 35 bighas, 2 kathas and 2 chhataks which is equivalent 11-2/3 acres CS plot No. 254 (in full) is suit plot. Suit plot No. 254 (in full ) along with other plots (full or part) had been noted in the schedule. Exhibit-4 is final survey performed by Dhaka Improvement Trust in respect of leased out 35 bighas, 2 kathas and 2 chhataks. Final survey had been performed on 21-12-1979. Exhibit 4(Ka) is map showing CS Plot No. 254 and other leased out plots.
